When the fringes of the cloud encompassed the place, there burst forth as from its belly a whirlwind and wrought sudden devastation in a fashion none had ever seen before or could afterwards forget.

arxiv-1611-00247.title: Foldy-Wouthuysen Green’s function and WKB transfer matrix method for Dirac tunneling through monolayer graphene with a mass gap
arxiv-1611-00247.creator: Mark Behzad Doost
arxiv-1611-00247.description: Abstract I provide a transfer matrix method for the Foldy-Wouthuysen representation of the Dirac equation. I derive the relationship between the reflection and transmission coefficients of the Dirac spinors and the wavefunction in the transformed representation. I develop a WKB approximation for Dirac fermions that has the same elegant form as the WKB solution to Schrödinger’s equation.

arxiv-2003-07958.creator: Freddy CACHAZO a and Nick EARLY b
arxiv-2003-07958.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Freddy CACHAZO a and Nick EARLY b. In this note we present a formula for the Cachazo–Early–Guevara–Mizera (CEGM) generalized biadjoint amplitudes for all k k and n n on what we call the minimal kinematics . We prove that on the minimal kinematics, the scattering equations on the configuration space of n n points on ℂ ​ ℙ k − 1 \mathbb{CP}^{k-1} has a unique solution, and that this solution is in the image of a Veronese embedding.

arxiv-2104-12451.description: Abstract UUITP-20/21 a Department of Physics, Faculty of Arts and Sciences, Middle East Technical University, 06800, Ankara, Turkey b Department of Physics and Astronomy, Theoretical Physics, Uppsala University SE-751 20 Uppsala, Sweden Abstract New relations involving the Riemann, Ricci and Einstein tensors that have to hold for a given geometry to admit Killing-Yano tensors are described.

arxiv-2211-05836.title: Strong Lensing Parameter Estimation on Ground-Based Imaging Data Using Simulation-Based Inference
arxiv-2211-05836.creator: Jason Poh, Ashwin Samudre, Aleksandra Ćiprijanović, Brian Nord, Gourav Khullar, Dimitrios Tanoglidis, Joshua A. Frieman
arxiv-2211-05836.description: Abstract Current ground-based cosmological surveys, such as the Dark Energy Survey (DES), are predicted to discover thousands of galaxy-scale strong lenses, while future surveys, such as the Vera Rubin Observatory Legacy Survey of Space and Time (LSST) will increase that number by 1-2 orders of magnitude.

Weilbacher, Davor Krajnović, Leindert Boogaard, Nicolas Bouché, Thierry Contini, Benoit Epinat, Anna Feltre, Yucheng Guo, Christian Herenz, Wolfram Kollatschny, Haru
arxiv-2211-08493.description: Abstract We present the second data release of the MUSE Hubble Ultra-Deep Field surveys, which includes the deepest spectroscopic survey ever performed. The MUSE data, with their 3D content, amazing depth, wide spectral range, and excellent spatial and medium spectral resolution, are rich in information.

arxiv-2305-04402.title: TaLU: A Hybrid Activation Function Combining Tanh and Rectified Linear Unit to Enhance Neural Networks
arxiv-2305-04402.creator: Md. Mehedi Hasan, Md. Ali Hossain, Azmain Yakin Srizon, Abu Sayeed
arxiv-2305-04402.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Md. Mehedi Hasan, Md. Ali Hossain, Azmain Yakin Srizon, Abu Sayeed. The application of the deep learning model in classification plays an important role in the accurate detection of the target objects. However, the accuracy is affected by the activation function in the hidden and output layer. In this paper, an activation function called TaLU, which is a combination of Tanh and Rectified Linear Units (ReLU), is used to improve the prediction.

arxiv-2305-05694.title: A Local Universe model for constrained simulations 2022 A Local Universe model for constrained simulations – 8
arxiv-2305-05694.creator: Simon Pfeifer, Aurélien Valade, Stefan Gottlöber, Yehuda Hoffman, Noam I. Libeskind, Wojciech A. Hellwing
arxiv-2305-05694.description: Abstract The aim of cosmological simulations is to reproduce the properties of the observed Universe, serving as tools to test structure and galaxy formation models. Constrained simulations of our local cosmological region up to a few hundred h − 1 ​ Mpc h^{-1}\,\mbox{Mpc} , the local Universe, are designed to reproduce the actual cosmic web of structures as observed.

arxiv-2409-14307.title: DilateQuant: Accurate and Efficient Quantization-Aware Training for Diffusion Models via Weight Dilation
arxiv-2409-14307.creator: Xuewen Liu 1,2 , Zhikai Li 1, , Minhao Jiang 1,2 , Mengjuan Chen 1 {}^{1\;} , Jianquan Li 1 {}^{1\;} , Qingyi Gu 1, 1 Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences 2 School of Artificial Intelligence, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences {liuxuewen2023, lizhikai2020, qingyi.gu}@ia.ac.cn
arxiv-2409-14307.description: Abstract . Model quantization is a promising method for accelerating and compressing diffusion models. Nevertheless, since post-training quantization (PTQ) fails catastrophically at low-bit cases, quantization-aware training (QAT) is essential. Unfortunately, the wide range and time-varying activations in diffusion models sharply increase the complexity of quantization, making existing QAT methods inefficient.

arxiv-2501-07698.title: Circle graphs and the automorphism group of the circle
arxiv-2501-07698.creator: Agelos Georgakopoulos
arxiv-2501-07698.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Agelos Georgakopoulos. We prove that Aut ⁡ ( 𝕊 1 ) \mathrm{Aut}(\mathbb{S}^{1}) coincides with the automorphism group of the circle graph 𝒞 \mathcal{C} , i.e. the intersection graph of the family of chords of 𝕊 1 \mathbb{S}^{1} . We prove that the countable subgraph of 𝒞 \mathcal{C} induced by the rational chords is a strongly universal element of the family of circle graphs, and that it is invariant under local complementation.

arxiv-2505-02288.title: Universal Approximation Theorem of Deep Q-Networks
arxiv-2505-02288.creator: Qian Qi
arxiv-2505-02288.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Qian Qi. We establish a continuous-time framework for analyzing Deep Q-Networks (DQNs) via stochastic control and Forward-Backward Stochastic Differential Equations (FBSDEs). Considering a continuous-time Markov Decision Process (MDP) driven by a square-integrable martingale, we analyze DQN approximation properties. We show that DQNs can approximate the optimal Q-function on compact sets with arbitrary accuracy and high probability, leveraging residual network approximation theorems and large deviation bounds for the state-action process.

pmc-11481640.title: Low-dose methadone added to another opioid for cancer pain: a multicentre prospective study
pmc-11481640.creator: Erwan Treillet, Elise Perceau-Chambard, Guillaume Economos, Luc Chevalier, Stéphane Picard, Matthieu Frasca, Julie Pouget, Laurent Calvel, Flora Tremellat-Faliere, Maxime Majerus, Paul Antoine Quesnel, Romain Chiquet, Adrien Evin, Marie-Anne Seveque, Audrey Lebel, Ines Hardouin, Alexis Burnod, Olivi
pmc-11481640.description: ContextThe use of methadone for cancer pain management is gaining wider acceptance. However, switching to methadone treatment can still pose challenges. Consequently, there is ongoing development of its use in low doses in combination with other opioids, despite a lack of clinical evidence regarding its efficacy and safety.

pmc-11608335.title: Paradigm of engineering recalcitrant non-model microorganism with dominant metabolic pathway as a biorefinery chassis
pmc-11608335.creator: Xiongying Yan, Weiwei Bao, Yalun Wu, Chenyue Zhang, Zhitao Mao, Qianqian Yuan, Zhousheng Hu, Penghui He, Qiqun Peng, Mimi Hu, Binan Geng, Hongwu Ma, Shouwen Chen, Qiang Fei, Qiaoning He, Shihui Yang
pmc-11608335.description: The development and implementation of microbial chassis cells have profound impacts on circular economy. Non-model bacterium Zymomonas mobilis is an excellent chassis owing to its extraordinary industrial characteristics. Here, the genome-scale metabolic model iZM516 is improved and updated by integrating enzyme constraints to simulate the dynamics of flux distribution and guide pathway design.

pmc-12387297.title: Discovery of a Hepatoprotective Trinor-Sesterterpenoid from the Marine Fungus Talaromyces sp. Against Hepatic Ischemia-Reperfusion Injury
pmc-12387297.creator: Wenxun Lan, Jian Cai, Liyan Yan, Xinyi Wu, Lisha Zhang, Chunmei Chen, Zhongqiu Liu, Xuefeng Zhou, Lan Tang, Vassilios Roussis
pmc-12387297.description: A new trinor-sesterterpenoid penitalarin D (1), with a 3,6-dioxabicyclo[3.1.0]hexane moiety, as well as two known compounds, penitalarin C (2) and nafuredin A (3), were obtained from the mangrove sediment-derived Talaromyces sp. SCSIO 41412. Their structures were determined by detailed NMR, MS spectroscopic analyses, and ECD calculations.

pmc-12474399.title: Effects of ZnFe2O4 Nanoparticles on Development and Rhythmic Behavior of Drosophila melanogaster
pmc-12474399.creator: Wenhao Yan, Yunfan Guo, Penghui Li, Ziyan Zhang, Jinjun Yang, Yongyan Sun, Yankai Xia, Ruijia Zhang, Jamie L Inman
pmc-12474399.description: Objectives: This study planned to determine the biological effects associated with ZnFe2O4-NPs exposure using Drosophila melanogaster as an in vivo model. Methods: ZnFe2O4-NPs were hydrothermally synthesized, and the development of offspring flies were evaluated via dietary exposure to different doses of ZnFe2O4-NPs (0, 200, 400, 600 μg/mL). Rhythmic behaviors of parent male flies were monitored.

pmc-12698197.title: Virtual reality adaptation of Be EPIC: pre-implementation studies of person-centered dementia care training
pmc-12698197.creator: Marie Y Savundranayagam, Grace Norris, Annette Schumann, Allison Chen, Jennifer Campos, Joseph B Orange, Howard B Degenholtz
pmc-12698197.description: Background and ObjectivesPerson-centered communication is critical in dementia care, yet personal support workers (PSWs) often lack sufficient training, which can reduce care quality. Be EPIC is an in-person training that teaches learners to build person-centered communication skills using actor-based simulations. A virtual reality (VR) version of Be EPIC was developed to expand access and consistency.

pmc-13111671.title: Cilia-driven surface currents characterize specific cnidarian groups and lifecycle stages
pmc-13111671.creator: Theres Koch, Karina Araslanova, Thibault Bouderlique, Anton Fetisov, Oliver Link, Alexander Klimovich, Milena Mičić, Klara Mičić, Johan Boström, Pedro Frade, Daniel Abed-Navandi, Igor Adameyko
pmc-13111671.description: In sessile animals, body surface-associated water currents are essential for integrating feeding, cleaning, and boosting metabolic exchange across colonies or communities of solitary individuals. The evolutionary origins of surface currents and their distribution among cnidarians remain poorly understood. Here, we investigated directional surface currents by tracking moving fluorescent beads on live specimens.

pmc-13145458.title: ABSTRACT NUMBER: ESOC2026A1571 DETERMINANTS OF GENERAL PRACTITIONER FOLLOW UP AFTER STROKE: THE SOUTH LONDON STROKE REGISTER
pmc-13145458.creator: Ismail Ismail, Camila Pantoja Ruiz, Evelyn Lim, Eva S Emmett, Matthew Dl O’connell, Charles Wolfe, Ajay Bhalla, Iain Marshall
pmc-13145458.description: Background and aimsStroke survivors require follow-up for secondary prevention and complication management. This study determined GP follow-up one-year post-discharge, temporal trends and associated factors.MethodsPopulation-based cohort study using the South London Stroke Register (1995-2024) of 8,458 people with first-ever stroke. Follow-up interviews at 3 months and 1-year assessed patient-reported GP contact, excluding deaths.

pmc-13199406.title: Anticancer potential of radioactively activated zinc: mechanisms and therapeutic applications
pmc-13199406.creator: Ferdane Danışman Kalındemirtaş, Güneş Özen Eroğlu, Esra Nazlıgül, İshak Afşin Kariper
pmc-13199406.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Zinc (Zn), an essential trace element, has been shown to exhibit antiproliferative effects at high concentrations and to serve various functions in human health. Numerous studies have been undertaken to enhance the efficacy of zinc. In this study, the therapeutic efficacy of zinc in terms of activation by ionizing radiation was investigated, and whether this would increase its efficacy was determined. In this study, Zn-65 was detected by exposing zinc to X-rays using a novel approach.

pmc-13201969.title: Bilateral persistence of the proatlantal intersegmental arteries in moyamoya syndrome: illustrative case
pmc-13201969.creator: Aaron Higginbotham, Domenico Napoletano, Austin Reed, Frank De Stefano, Lane Fry, Ari Williams, Koji Ebersole, Jeremy Peterson
pmc-13201969.description: BACKGROUNDThe persistent proatlantal intersegmental artery (PPIA) arises from the cervical internal carotid artery (ICA) and joins the vertebral artery near the foramen magnum. In moyamoya syndrome (MMS), such embryonic carotid-vertebrobasilar channels may influence collateralization and procedural strategy. The authors report bilateral PPIA identified concurrently with bilateral MMS.OBSERVATIONSA 28-year-old woman with Down syndrome presented with sudden severe headache and unresponsiveness.

pmc-13323416.title: Integrated bulk and single-cell transcriptomic analyses identify transcriptome-defined groups and EGFR-associated microenvironmental programs in glioma
pmc-13323416.creator: Yuanhan Wang, Long Li, Xing Hu, Longhu Han, Yihan Zhang, Zhisen Zhou, Wei Liu, Song Yang
pmc-13323416.description: BackgroundGlioma exhibits significant molecular heterogeneity, necessitating improved understanding of molecular subtypes for personalized treatment strategies.MethodsThis study integrated bulk RNA sequencing (GSE35169) to derive transcriptome-defined groups and single-cell RNA sequencing (GSE131928) to characterize cellular heterogeneity and EGFR-associated malignant cell programs. Differential gene expression analysis identified subtype-specific biomarkers.

pmc-13665484.title: Response Quality of AI-Generated Answers to Orthodontic Patient Concerns Across Empathy, Accuracy, Comprehensiveness, Personalisation, Safety, and Patient-Centeredness: A Cross-Model, Bilingual Evaluation of Claude, GPT-4o, and Gemini
pmc-13665484.creator: Mustafa Ozcan, Ferdi Allaf
pmc-13665484.description: Background: Patients now consult large language models (LLMs) for orthodontic concerns, but most evaluations sit in English and focus on factual accuracy. We compared three current LLMs (Claude Opus 4.5, GPT-4o, Gemini 2.5 Flash) on patient-facing responses in English and Turkish, and tested whether model differences held up after adjusting for response length.

uslaw-usc-t7-s345.title: 7 U.S.C. § 345 — Replacement of diminished, lost or misapplied funds; restrictions on use; reports of colleges
uslaw-usc-t7-s345.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t7-s345.description: United States Code, Title 7 (Agriculture); Chapter 13 (Agricultural And Mechanical Colleges); Subchapter IV (Agricultural Extension Work Appropriation). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. If any portion of the moneys received by the designated officer of any State for the support and maintenance of cooperative agricultural extension work, as provided in this subchapter, shall by any action or contingency be diminished or lost.
